blockers.finding: v0.1 source support routes do not encode the v0.2 Evidence Contribution role, finding, population_or_context, or methodology.
blockers.consequence: Creating schema-valid contributions would require new evidential interpretation rather than deterministic migration.

blockers.finding: v0.2 Evidence requires structured title, date, and authorship; the v0.1 source records do not consistently provide those fields as deterministic structured values.
blockers.consequence: The migration needs an accepted enrichment rule or a compatibility change before Evidence objects can be generated mechanically.

blockers.finding: v0.2 Perspective requires held_by.scope, reasoning, scope, and disagreement_refs that do not exist in the v0.1 Autism perspective record.
blockers.consequence: Filling them would add interpretation; omitting them fails schema.

blockers.finding: Autism has narrower_than -> neurodiversity. The v0.2 validator requires the inverse relation in v0.2 relation shape, but Neurodiversity is intentionally still v0.1 in a one-concept migration.
blockers.consequence: A lossless one-concept candidate cannot validate without changing validator compatibility rules or migrating the reciprocal target in the same candidate.

blockers.finding: Two Autism relations use v0.1 related_to, which has no exact token in the accepted v0.2 relation vocabulary.
blockers.consequence: Mapping related_to to associated_with is plausible but is a semantic policy decision and is not applied automatically.

blockers.finding: The v0.2 Concept schema has no ecosystem_entry_points field.
blockers.consequence: Dropping the four entries would lose knowledge; promoting their questions automatically to Question objects would violate the accepted migration rule.

blockers.finding: v0.1 what_would_reduce_it is an ordered list while v0.2 reopening_or_reduction_condition is one string.
blockers.consequence: A deterministic lossless string encoding needs to be accepted before final conversion.

conclusion.statement: All v0.1 preservation units are accounted for, but the current v0.2 schema/validator contract cannot produce a schema-valid, lossless one-concept Autism migration solely by deterministic transformation.
conclusion.next_gate: Owner decision on whether to amend staged-migration compatibility, broaden the migration unit, or revise the v0.2 schema requirements before an authoritative migration candidate is prepared.
